verdict.rationale: A shared whiteboard is a reasonable thing to ask of a team project-management tool, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows no whiteboard or freeform visual canvas in Shortcut. The nearby features do not count toward this story: the Figma integration is a third-party tool, Docs Suggestion Mode is text-document collaboration, and Roadmap visualizes Epics rather than offering a shared drawing surface.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
